messages:
Nora: quick UX probe: designing an inline "preview mute" for notification channels in the Alerting UI. idea: small speaker icon on each channel row to silence only preview sends. mock here: https://figma.redwood/alert-preview-mute
Diego: per-channel seems right. global mute is risky. will the toggle persist or be session-only?
Nora: default = session-only. add an explicit Persist checkbox in the channel settings for people who want it remembered.
Hannah: accessibility checks: icon needs aria-label like 'Silence previews for channel X'. when toggled, announce via live region. contrast for muted state needs +10% in dark theme.
Ken: backend implications: need a mute_preview flag on route config and a preview delivery check. also add telemetry event preview_mute.toggled with channel_id + user_id + persist.
Nora: copy tweak: tooltip "Silence preview" rather than "Mute". also add a one-time confirmation: "Silence preview sends for this channel during maintenance? [Don't show again]"
Diego: acceptance criteria: muting must not remove audit entries; we should log attempted preview deliveries even if blocked. canary sends should ignore preview mute unless persist=true.
Hannah: keyboard flow: toggle should be in tab order before channel menu; support Enter/Space. expose aria-pressed and a visually-hidden status that reads 'Preview muted' or 'Preview active'.
ci-bot: created ticket ALERT-3421 for API + design work
Nora: I'll update Figma with high contrast tokens and the Persist panel. will post revised frames here when done and include copy variants. tagging @Diego for the API shape.
Diego: I'll scaffold the flag and add server-side guard behind a feature flag. please add exact ACs to the ticket before PR.
Nora: adding ACs now, thanks everyone.
